behavior: Stage changes is unavailable without desired-state edits.
Deploy changes requires a current, unapplied infrastructure plan.
Health checks and capture require deployed staging machines.
Successful task notices and finished task popups expose the next workflow actions.
Review changes opens an infrastructure plan with Restage changes and Deploy changes.

Release selection is labeled Deploy release.
deployment_scope: Static web UI only; no lab resources were redeployed.
